main_axis.headline: You turn pressure and demands into money and tangible results.
main_axis.body: The lead force is Direct Wealth — steady income built bit by bit, and Indirect Wealth — a nose for opportunities and mobilizing resources; they sit jointly heaviest. Next comes Direct Resource — systems, credentials, and backing. Hidden and unused is the Officer-Killings family: external pressure and formal standing.
main_axis.evidence: Direct Wealth carries weight 12 (month stem Ding Fire, plus hidden Direct Wealth in year branch Wu Fire, day branch Xu Earth, and hour branch Wu Fire); Indirect Wealth carries weight 10 (year stem Bing Fire, hour stem Bing Fire, plus year and hour branch hidden stems); Direct Resource carries weight 4 (month branch You Metal hidden stem Xin, day branch Xu Earth hidden stem Xin); Seven Killings carries weight 3 (day branch Xu Earth hidden stem Wu); Direct Officer carries weight 2 (year and hour branch hidden stem Ji Earth). Companion and Output families carry zero weight.

core_loop.headline: Demands arrive, you bank them as income, and the cycle repeats.
core_loop.flow: When expectations land on your plate — whether from a boss, a client, or a family obligation — you fulfill them and immediately turn fulfillment into something you can save or spend. The loop runs tight: external demand becomes deliverable, deliverable becomes cash or credit, and the next demand is already waiting.
core_loop.driver: The Day Master shows special-pattern traits (从格特征); the useful-god list is empty. Wealth is overwhelmingly heavy (22 combined weight, nearly half the chart); Officer-Killings and Resource sit light (5 and 4). The engine withholds standard strength conclusions.
core_loop.leak:
The cost is that you rarely challenge the incoming demand or ask whether it serves you — fulfillment becomes automatic, and when no one is asking, momentum stalls.
In the ten years starting around age 43 (the 壬辰 pillar), your own judgment returns to the chart, and pausing to question becomes easier.
For now, before saying yes, write down what you gain and what you spend; treat your own time as a line item.
core_loop.evidence: Officer-Killings to Wealth: Seven Killings (Wu Earth in day branch hidden stem) and Direct Officer (Ji Earth in year and hour branch hidden stems) feed Wealth (Bing and Ding Fire in visible stems, hidden Direct Wealth and Indirect Wealth across all branches). The 壬辰 pillar starting at age 43 brings Ren Water stem (Companion) and Chen Earth branch (Officer-Killings and Resource); Companion allows self-directed judgment. Current chart shows zero Companion and zero Output weight; the entire visible surface is Wealth (year, month, and hour stems all carry Wealth).

structure_type.name: the fulfillment-first executor
structure_type.one_line: Demand flows in, you turn it into results and bank it as income; the chart runs on responding to what others need rather than generating from within.

capability_source.headline: Strongest when someone hands you a clear request and you must deliver by a deadline; weakest when you must invent the goal yourself.
capability_source.text: The dominant Wealth energy converts external asks into concrete output with minimal delay. A relative says the roof leaks, and by evening you have found the roofer, negotiated the price, and scheduled the repair — the whole transaction closes before the requester finishes describing the problem. Your speed comes from reading what is needed and moving to fulfill it immediately, without inner debate.
capability_source.evidence: Strength: Wealth (Direct and Indirect combined at 22 weight) sits on every visible stem except the Day Master itself; Resource (weight 4) provides just enough structure to organize delivery. Weakness: zero Companion and zero Output weight means no self-generated direction and no natural urge to produce for its own sake; capability depends entirely on external demand arriving first. The leak paragraph already explained the momentum-stall cost when no one is asking.

structure_fingerprint: Wealth dominates the visible surface; Officer-Killings and Resource sit light; Companion and Output are missing; fulfillment converts demand into income.
